description.default: Finds and displays the user's Microsoft Planner projects. Use all for a project overview, urgent for incomplete tasks that are overdue or due within seven days, and onHold for incomplete tasks in On hold, Hold, In hold, or Blocked buckets. A selected project opens its native Planner board in fullscreen.

Prepares an editable review for a new basic Microsoft Planner project. Resolves relative dates to an exact date, recommends a blank, simple, project management, software development, business plan, or employee onboarding template, lets the user select a Microsoft 365 group, and creates the plan only after an explicit button click.
